rationale: The porch camera is offline with battery at 7% and the base station log shows a "battery level 7%" warning. A comparable camera (Garden Cam, same model/firmware, similar RSSI) is online at 17% battery, ruling out a network or firmware issue. Low battery on a battery camera causes live view to fail to start and the device to go offline.

repair_steps: Instruct the customer to recharge the Porch Cam battery using the provided USB cable and power adapter until it reaches at least 20%.
After charging, ask the customer to verify the camera is online in the app and test live view.
If the camera remains offline after charging, perform a manual reboot by pressing and holding the reset button for 10 seconds, then re-add the camera to the base station if necessary.
Advise the customer to consider a solar panel or higher-capacity battery if low battery recurs frequently.
output.customer_reply: Thank you for your patience. We've identified that your Porch Cam's battery is critically low at 7%, which is causing it to go offline and prevent live view. Please recharge the camera using the included cable and adapter until it reaches at least 20%. Once charged, it should reconnect automatically. If you continue to experience issues after charging, let us know and we'll assist further.

complaint: The porch camera won't start live view; it just spins and then says camera unavailable. It started a couple of days ago. I thought it was the Wi-Fi because our router was updated recently, so I rebooted the router twice, but nothing changed. The other cameras are fine.
